description: This source file defines the ActivationId struct, which uniquely identifies a grain activation within the Orleans distributed virtual actor system. It includes methods for creating, parsing, and comparing activation IDs, along with a JSON converter for serialization.

classes.name: ActivationId
classes.description: A readonly struct that uniquely identifies a grain activation in Orleans. It provides methods for creation, serialization, comparison, and deterministic generation based on a GrainId.

classes.name: ActivationIdConverter
classes.description: A JsonConverter for serializing and deserializing ActivationId instances to and from JSON.

methods.name: ActivationId
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new ActivationId with a specified Guid.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether the ActivationId is the default value.

methods.name: GetDeterministic
methods.description: Generates a deterministic ActivationId from a GrainId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the ActivationId.

methods.name: ToParsableString
methods.description: Returns a parseable string representation of the ActivationId.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Parses a string into an ActivationId.
